title: Grilled Portuguese Chicken with Blackeye Peas
description: A delicious and flavorful dish that combines the rich taste of Portuguese chicken with the creamy texture of blackeye peas, all grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: portuguese seasonings
ingredients.notes: a blend of herbs and spices

instructions: Season chicken breasts with Portuguese seasonings.
Brush grill with light olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat blackeye peas in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped pea shoots to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Serve grilled chicken with blackeye pea mixture.
Garnish with additional pea shoots if desired.
